description: This file contains utility methods for entity model handling in the Apache OFBiz framework, including string conversions, naming conventions, type inference, and localization checks.

classes.name: ModelUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for model and string manipulation, naming conversions, type inference, and localization checks within OFBiz.

methods.name: upperFirstChar
methods.description: Converts the first character of the input string to uppercase.

methods.name: lowerFirstChar
methods.description: Converts the first character of the input string to lowercase.

methods.name: dbNameToClassName
methods.description: Converts a database name, typically in all caps with underscores, to a Java class name in CamelCase with the first letter capitalized.

methods.name: dbNameToVarName
methods.description: Converts a database name in all caps with underscores to a Java variable name in camelCase.

methods.name: javaNameToDbName
methods.description: Converts a Java variable name in camelCase to a database name in all caps with underscores.

methods.name: shortenDbName
methods.description: Shortens a database name to a desired length by removing vowels and characters in specific segments, preserving uniqueness.

methods.name: packageToPath
methods.description: Converts a Java package name into a file path by replacing dots with platform-specific file separators.

methods.name: replaceString
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring within a string with a new string.

methods.name: induceFieldType
methods.description: Infers a field type based on SQL type information such as name, length, and precision.

methods.name: isPotentialLocalizedField
methods.description: Checks if a ModelEntity potentially has a default resource for localization for a given field.

methods.name: isPotentialLocalizedFields
methods.description: Checks if a ModelEntity potentially has default resources for localization for a list of fields.
